theorems.name: Submission.ts_fv_piece_image_area_formula
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (C : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))) (F : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → Ambient n ℓ) (f : Ambient n ℓ → Ambient n ℓ) (A : Set (Ambient n ℓ)) (P : Ambient n ℓ → Submodule ℝ (Ambient n ℓ)) (w : Ambient n ℓ → ℝ≥0∞), MeasurableSet C → (∃ L : NNReal, LipschitzWith L F) → (∀ v ∈ C, DifferentiableAt ℝ F v) → Set.InjOn F C → (∃ L : NNReal, LipschitzWith L f) → Set.InjOn f A → (∀ y ∈ A, DifferentiableAt ℝ f y) → MeasurableSet A → A ⊆ F '' C → (∀ v ∈ C, F v ∈ A → P (F v) = LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ F v).toLinearMap) → ∫⁻ y in f '' A, w y ∂μHE[n] = ∫⁻ y in A, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt (Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun i j : Fin (n + ℓ) ↦ inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ f y ((P y).starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)))) (fderiv ℝ f y ((P y).starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ)))) + inner ℝ (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ) - (P y).starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ))) (EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ) - (P y).starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ)))))) * w (f y) ∂μHE[n]
